payload.friendly_name: Consolidate target-branch tip-capture helper + reclaim tasks-lifecycle squad MINORs
payload.purpose_context: Spec Kitty's planning-pin classifier trusts whatever target-branch tip its callers hand it, but two different helpers capture that tip with divergent ambiguity/error handling — a latent drift the earlier classification-consolidation left open. This mission gives tip-capture a single canonical authority with a documented contract, and opportunistically clears two low-risk squad-flagged nits in the same tasks-to-lanes-to-finalize lifecycle.
payload.purpose_tldr: Give 'the target-branch tip' one canonical owner so finalize and the lane consumers can never silently disagree, and fold two adjacent tasks-lifecycle tidies.
